evals.prompt: I'm adding rate limiting to a Hono API that runs on Cloudflare Workers. Find a few real open-source projects that do this and show me the common patterns before I pick one.
evals.expected_output: Searches GitHub with focused, filtered queries; cites several real repositories with file paths; compares the rate-limiting approaches they use (for example the Workers Rate Limiting binding, Durable Objects, KV or a middleware package) and recommends how to choose.
assertions: Runs real GitHub code searches (ghx or gh search code) and saves the commands in searches.txt
Narrows searches with filters such as language, extension, filename, path or repo
Cites at least 3 distinct real repositories with file paths or links
The cited files exist on GitHub (spot-check two of them)
Compares the rate-limiting approaches found (for example the Workers Rate Limiting binding, Durable Objects, KV, Upstash or hono-rate-limiter) with trade-offs
Gives guidance for choosing one approach, and doesn't recommend @hono-rate-limiter/cloudflare (unmaintained since 2024-12) without saying so
Summarizes patterns instead of pasting copied code: no single excerpt longer than about 10 lines
Checks that the packages or repos it recommends are maintained (last release, archived status or deprecation) and says so when one isn't
Reads the cited code closely enough to flag at least one bug, anti-pattern or caveat in it, rather than presenting every hit as correct
